openclaw.notes: Official default gateway image; bundled codex/diagnostics plugins; no browser variant, sandbox image, model or messaging account.

hermes.notes: Official default image, actual dashboard command with s6 supervision, host network and localhost binding as documented; no desktop variant, model or messaging gateway.

qwenpaw.notes: Official standard image and three state volumes, init enabled as official Compose; includes Chromium and desktop processes (Xvfb/Xfce/dbus). No configured model or messaging account.
